search_window.basis: From previous verified supplementary Gaza Source Watch completion through this execution; check newly issued or newly surfaced traceable developments, distinguish new warning from historical exposure data and exclude duplicate incident counts.

findings.title: Gaza civil defense warns heavy rains, strong winds threaten nearly 950,000 displaced Palestinians
findings.location: Gaza Strip; displacement tents, temporary shelters and structurally damaged buildings
findings.affected_population_system: Nearly 950,000 displaced Palestinians in moderate/high flood-risk sites (OCHA figures from 15 October, not a newly displaced count); over 400,000 in high flood-risk locations and approximately 44,000 in unsafe buildings. Actual newly affected count unknown.
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting new statement by Gaza Civil Defense Directorate, with historical UN OCHA exposure data
findings.summary: On 5 November Gaza Civil Defense issued a specific warning for expected rain and strong winds Friday, 6 November, urging shelter precautions and safe relocation away from damaged structures. The warning is newly issued; the approximately 950,000 exposure estimate comes from OCHA's 15 October data. No new flood casualties, actual displacement, or infrastructure failure were reported.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: heavy rainfall and strong winds expected Friday could endanger displaced Palestinians living in tents and temporary shelters

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_source: Anadolu direct Middle East index; opened original dated 5 November article following first OCHA OPT and WHO checks and 12 additional targeted searches.
bounded_discovery_context.uniqueness: Previous verified watch did not record this 5 November Civil Defense advisory. Distinct from older OCHA 15 October population-at-risk statistic and prior Rafah flood-control mission interruption.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: No independent first-party Civil Defense statement was located in bounded checks; reported exposed-population numbers are historical, not new confirmed impacts; article displays date but no clock time.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary Gaza recall only; authoritative daily production collector and publication unchanged.

official_first_checks.result: Accessible; 5 Nov homepage showed retrospective wheelchair rehabilitation profile and September appeal monitoring. Latest posted situation report 29 October. No new verified operational change in this observation window.
WHO global Gaza emergency landing accessible; linked regional and general news pre-November. Regional EMRO Gaza emergency page inaccessible in this tool, a recurring limitation.

exclusions.item: WAFA 5 November 17:24 article: 74,618 total deaths, 175,925 injuries, 5 hospital-received injured in last 24h
exclusions.reason: Aggregate follow-up with no identifiable distinct incident; may overlap existing recorded 5 November casualty reports. Not a verified new civilian-impact incident. Do not infer three new deaths from comparison with 3 November cumulative data.

exclusions.reason: Underlying exposure statistics were already published by OCHA on 15 October; not separately counted as new finding. Only the dated Civil Defense weather warning is new.

degradation.status_reason: Recurring WHO EMRO Gaza regional page failed via web access, and UN News targeted search was robots-blocked; WHO global, OCHA, WAFA, Anadolu and other source results were accessible.
degradation.limitations: Older results polluted the targeted web search. Official Civil Defense original notice not directly located; the warning is documented by established Anadolu reporting. No new observed storm impact can be claimed.

coverage_notes.notification_decision: Notify: a distinct 5 November Civil Defense warning for 6 November extreme-weather exposure in Gaza displacement sites was newly documented. No incident-level casualties newly confirmed.
coverage_notes.safeguards: Exactly one ops/watch-ledger heartbeat only; no approvals, production changes, publication, deployments, schedule changes or task disablement.
